sources.label: Morphe Patches for Android apps by anxyis
sources.author: anxy
patch_list: Restores app text needed to keep everything working.
Hides the tutorial button and promo cards.
Sign in without needing a Google account.
Adds extra toggles in Developer Settings.
Unlocks the highest export resolution and layer limits.
Turns off the license check so pro features stay unlocked.
Stops the app from forcing you to update.
Removes license checks from every screen so no paywall pops up.
Unlocks pro encoder options, effects and settings.
Skips the startup block so the app opens straight into pro mode.
Small behind-the-scenes fixes that keep pro working.
